ucs.title: [LLM] Rhysida ransomware locker — .rhysida extension write + CriticalBreachDetected.pdf ransom note drop
ucs.description: Hunts the terminal stage of a Rhysida (CISA AA23-319A) intrusion: bulk file writes carrying the actor's signature `.rhysida` extension co-occurring with their characteristic `CriticalBreachDetected.pdf` ransom note dropped by the same process. Both artefacts are pathognomonic for this RaaS — they are not used by Vice Society, LockBit, BlackCat, or other lockers we currently track.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count as file_count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Filesystem.file_path) as paths values(Filesystem.file_name) as files dc(Filesystem.file_name) as distinct_files from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where (Filesystem.file_name="*.rhysida" OR Filesystem.file_name="CriticalBreachDetected.pdf") by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.process_guid Filesystem.user _time span=5m | eval has_note=if(match(mvjoin(files,","),"(?i)CriticalBreachDetected\.pdf"),1,0) | where file_count>=5 AND (has_note=1 OR distinct_files>=5) | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)` | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | join type=left process_guid [| tstats summariesonly=t values(Processes.process_name) as launcher values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent values(Processes.process) as cmdline from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes by Processes.process_guid | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`] | sort - firstTime
ucs.kql:
let RhysidaExt = ".rhysida";
let RansomNote = "criticalbreachdetected.pdf";
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileRenamed","FileModified")
| where FileName endswith RhysidaExt or tolower(FileName) == RansomNote
| extend ArtefactType = iff(tolower(FileName) == RansomNote, "RansomNote", "EncryptedFile")
| summarize FileCount = count(),
            DistinctEncrypted = dcountif(FileName, ArtefactType == "EncryptedFile"),
            NoteDrops = countif(ArtefactType == "RansomNote"),
            SampleFiles = make_set(FileName, 10),
            DistinctFolders = dcount(FolderPath),
            SampleFolders = make_set(FolderPath, 10),
            FirstSeen = min(Timestamp),
            LastSeen = max(Timestamp)
            by DeviceId, DeviceName,
               InitiatingProcessId,
               InitiatingProcessFileName,
               InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
               InitiatingProcessAccountName,
               InitiatingProcessParentFileName,
               InitiatingProcessSHA256
| where FileCount >= 5
      and (NoteDrops >= 1 or DistinctEncrypted >= 5)        // ransom-note OR fan-out across files
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let RhysidaExt = ".rhysida";
let RansomNote = "criticalbreachdetected.pdf";
ImFileEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventType in ("FileCreated","FileRenamed","FileModified")
| where tolower(TargetFileName) endswith RhysidaExt
      or tolower(TargetFileName) endswith RansomNote
| extend ArtefactType = iff(tolower(TargetFileName) endswith RansomNote, "RansomNote", "EncryptedFile")
| summarize FileCount = count(),
            DistinctEncrypted = dcountif(TargetFileName, ArtefactType == "EncryptedFile"),
            NoteDrops = countif(ArtefactType == "RansomNote"),
            SampleFiles = make_set(TargetFileName, 10),
            DistinctFolders = dcount(TargetFilePath),
            FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
            LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated),
            Process = any(ActingProcessName),
            Cmd = any(ActingProcessCommandLine)
            by DvcHostname, ActingProcessId, ActorUsername
| where FileCount >= 5
      and (NoteDrops >= 1 or DistinctEncrypted >= 5)
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Rhysida Ransomware Encrypted-File Extension or Ransom Note Drop
id: 7b9c1a14-3e02-4d65-a3b8-d3f2e8c69a01
status: experimental
description: Detects file writes carrying the Rhysida `.rhysida` extension or the actor's `CriticalBreachDetected.pdf` ransom note — both unique to the Rhysida RaaS family (CISA AA23-319A).
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa23-319a
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/19
tags:
  - attack.impact
  - attack.t1486
  - threat.rhysida
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_extension:
    TargetFilename|endswith: '.rhysida'
  selection_ransom_note:
    TargetFilename|endswith: 'CriticalBreachDetected.pdf'
  condition: 1 of selection_*
fields:
  - Image
  - ProcessId
  - TargetFilename
  - User
falsepositives:
  - Authorised IR/forensics labs replaying captured samples
level: critical
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:11 (@TargetFilename:(*\\*.rhysida OR *\\*.RHYSIDA OR *\\*.Rhysida) OR @TargetFilename:(*\\CriticalBreachDetected.pdf OR *\\criticalbreachdetected.pdf OR *\\CRITICALBREACHDETECTED.PDF))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=FileWritten
| TargetFileName=/\.rhysida$/i OR TargetFileName=/CriticalBreachDetected\.pdf$/i
| RansomNote := if(TargetFileName=/CriticalBreachDetected\.pdf$/i, then=1, else=0)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ContextProcessId, ContextImageFileName], function=[count(as=Files), sum(RansomNote, as=NoteCount), min(@timestamp, as=FirstSeen), max(@timestamp, as=LastSeen), collect([TargetFileName], limit=10)])
| Files >= 5
| NoteCount >= 1 OR Files >= 10
ucs.rationale: The `.rhysida` extension and `CriticalBreachDetected.pdf` ransom note are signature artefacts unique to the Rhysida RaaS (per CISA #StopRansomware AA23-319A and joint advisory with FBI / MS-ISAC, Nov 2023). LockBit drops `restore-my-files.txt`, BlackCat drops `RECOVER-${ext}-FILES.txt`, Akira uses `akira_readme.txt` — none of these collide. Joining the file fan-out to the InitiatingProcess pivots

ucs.title: [LLM] Rhysida pre-encryption 'clean room' — chained VSS deletion + recovery disable + log wipe + Defender tamper
ucs.description: Hunts the documented Rhysida pre-encryption preparation routine where the operator chains shadow-copy deletion (`vssadmin`/`wmic`), Windows Recovery Environment disable (`bcdedit`), event-log wipe (`wevtutil cl`), and Defender real-time-protection disable inside a single short window on the same host. CISA AA23-319A and Microsoft both attribute this exact sequence to Rhysida affiliates ahead of locker rollout via PsExec — three or more of these techniques in <10 min on a host with no prior baseline of admin maintenance is high-fidelity actor behaviour.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process_name) as procs values(Processes.process) as cmdlines values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parents from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name=vssadmin.exe AND Processes.process="*delete shadows*") OR (Processes.process_name=wmic.exe AND Processes.process="*shadowcopy*" AND Processes.process="*delete*") OR (Processes.process_name=bcdedit.exe AND (Processes.process="*recoveryenabled No*" OR Processes.process="*bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures*")) OR (Processes.process_name=wevtutil.exe AND Processes.process="*cl *") OR ((Processes.process_name=powershell.exe OR Processes.process_name=pwsh.exe) AND Processes.process="*Set-MpPreference*" AND Processes.process="*DisableRealtimeMonitoring*") OR (Processes.process_name=net.exe AND (Processes.process="*stop \"Windows Defender\"*" OR Processes.process="*stop MpsSvc*" OR Processes.process="*stop VSS*" OR Processes.process="*stop BITS*")) by Processes.dest Processes.user _time span=10m | eval technique=case(match(mvjoin(procs,","),"vssadmin\.exe") OR match(mvjoin(cmdlines,","),"shadowcopy.*delete"),"ShadowDelete", match(mvjoin(procs,","),"bcdedit"),"RecoveryDisable", match(mvjoin(procs,","),"wevtutil"),"LogClear", match(mvjoin(cmdlines,","),"(?i)DisableRealtimeMonitoring"),"DefenderDisable", match(mvjoin(cmdlines,","),"(?i)stop \"?(Windows Defender|MpsSvc|VSS|BITS)\"?"),"ServiceStop", "Other") | stats min(firstTime) as firstTime max(lastTime) as lastTime values(technique) as techniques dc(technique) as technique_count values(procs) as procs values(cmdlines) as cmdlines values(parents) as parents by Processes.dest Processes.user | where technique_count>=3 | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)` | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | sort - firstTime
ucs.kql:
let lookback = 7d;
let window = 10m;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(lookback)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"                                      // exclude machine accounts
| where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| where (FileName =~ "vssadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete" and ProcessCommandLine has "shadows")
     or (FileName =~ "wmic.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "shadowcopy" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete")
     or (FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("recoveryenabled No","bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures"))
     or (FileName =~ "wevtutil.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "cl ")
     or (FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe") and ProcessCommandLine has "Set-MpPreference" and ProcessCommandLine has "DisableRealtimeMonitoring")
     or (FileName =~ "net.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "stop" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("Windows Defender","MpsSvc","VSS","BITS","WinDefend"))
     or (FileName =~ "sc.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("config WinDefend start= disabled","stop WinDefend"))
| extend Behaviour = case(
    FileName =~ "vssadmin.exe" or (FileName =~ "wmic.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "shadowcopy"), "ShadowDelete",
    FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe", "RecoveryDisable",
    FileName =~ "wevtutil.exe", "LogClear",
    ProcessCommandLine has "DisableRealtimeMonitoring", "DefenderDisable",
    FileName =~ "net.exe" or FileName =~ "sc.exe", "ServiceStop",
    "Other")
| summarize BehaviourSet = make_set(Behaviour),
            DistinctBehaviours = dcount(Behaviour),
            CommandSamples = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 15),
            ParentTree = make_set(InitiatingProcessFileName, 5),
            FirstSeen = min(Timestamp),
            LastSeen = max(Timestamp),
            EventCount = count()
            by DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, bin(Timestamp, window)
| where DistinctBehaviours >= 3                                        // 3-of-N chain = actor signature
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let lookback = 7d;
let window = 10m;
ImProcessCreate
| where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
| where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
| where ActorUsername !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| where (ActingProcessName endswith "vssadmin.exe" and ActingProcessCommandLine has "delete" and ActingProcessCommandLine has "shadows")
     or (ActingProcessName endswith "wmic.exe" and ActingProcessCommandLine has "shadowcopy" and ActingProcessCommandLine has "delete")
     or (ActingProcessName endswith "bcdedit.exe" and ActingProcessCommandLine has_any ("recoveryenabled No","bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures"))
     or (ActingProcessName endswith "wevtutil.exe" and ActingProcessCommandLine has "cl ")
     or (ActingProcessName has_any ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe") and ActingProcessCommandLine has "Set-MpPreference" and ActingProcessCommandLine has "DisableRealtimeMonitoring")
     or (ActingProcessName endswith "net.exe" and ActingProcessCommandLine has "stop" and ActingProcessCommandLine has_any ("Windows Defender","MpsSvc","VSS","BITS","WinDefend"))
     or (ActingProcessName endswith "sc.exe" and ActingProcessCommandLine has_any ("config WinDefend start= disabled","stop WinDefend"))
| extend Behaviour = case(
    ActingProcessName endswith "vssadmin.exe" or (ActingProcessName endswith "wmic.exe" and ActingProcessCommandLine has "shadowcopy"), "ShadowDelete",
    ActingProcessName endswith "bcdedit.exe", "RecoveryDisable",
    ActingProcessName endswith "wevtutil.exe", "LogClear",
    ActingProcessCommandLine has "DisableRealtimeMonitoring", "DefenderDisable",
    ActingProcessName endswith "net.exe" or ActingProcessName endswith "sc.exe", "ServiceStop",
    "Other")
| summarize BehaviourSet = make_set(Behaviour),
            DistinctBehaviours = dcount(Behaviour),
            CommandSamples = make_set(ActingProcessCommandLine, 15),
            ParentTree = make_set(ParentProcessName, 5),

ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 ((@Image:(*\\vssadmin.exe OR *\\VSSADMIN.EXE) AND @CommandLine:*shadow*) OR (@Image:(*\\wmic.exe OR *\\WMIC.exe) AND @CommandLine:*shadowcopy* AND @CommandLine:*delete*) OR (@Image:(*\\bcdedit.exe OR *\\BCDEDIT.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*"recoveryenabled No"* OR *"bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures"*)) OR (@Image:(*\\wevtutil.exe OR *\\WEVTUTIL.EXE) AND @CommandLine:*"cl "*) OR (@Image:(*\\powershell.exe OR *\\PowerShell.exe OR *\\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\\pwsh.exe) AND @CommandLine:*Set-MpPreference* AND @CommandLine:*DisableRealtimeMonitoring*) OR (@Image:(*\\net.exe OR *\\NET.EXE) AND @CommandLine:*stop* AND @CommandLine:(*"Windows Defender"* OR *WinDefend* OR *MpsSvc* OR *VSS* OR *BITS*)) OR (@Image:(*\\sc.exe OR *\\SC.EXE) AND @CommandLine:*WinDefend*))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| (ImageFileName=/\\vssadmin\.exe$/i AND regex("(?i)delete\s+shadows", field=CommandLine))
  OR (ImageFileName=/\\wmic\.exe$/i AND regex("(?i)shadowcopy.*delete", field=CommandLine))
  OR (ImageFileName=/\\bcdedit\.exe$/i AND regex("(?i)(recoveryenabled\s+No|bootstatuspolicy\s+ignoreallfailures)", field=CommandLine))
  OR (ImageFileName=/\\wevtutil\.exe$/i AND regex("(?i)\bcl\b", field=CommandLine))
  OR (ImageFileName=/\\(powershell|pwsh)\.exe$/i AND regex("(?i)Set-MpPreference.*DisableRealtimeMonitoring", field=CommandLine))
  OR (ImageFileName=/\\net\.exe$/i AND regex("(?i)stop\s+\"?(Windows Defender|WinDefend|MpsSvc|VSS|BITS)\"?", field=CommandLine))
  OR (ImageFileName=/\\sc\.exe$/i AND regex("(?i)WinDefend", field=CommandLine))
| Behaviour := if(ImageFileName=/\\vssadmin\.exe$/i OR regex("(?i)shadowcopy", field=CommandLine), then="ShadowDelete", else=if(ImageFileName=/\\bcdedit\.exe$/i, then="RecoveryDisable", else=if(ImageFileName=/\\wevtutil\.exe$/i, then="LogClear", else=if(regex("(?i)DisableRealtimeMonitoring", field=CommandLine), then="DefenderDisable", else="ServiceStop"))))
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, bucket(span=10m)], function=[count(as=Events), collect([Behaviour], multival=true)])
| BehaviourCount := length(Behaviour)
| BehaviourCount >= 3
ucs.rationale: Rhysida's affiliate playbook (CISA AA23-319A + Microsoft Threat Intelligence reporting) consistently shows operators executing the same four-to-five-step pre-encryption hardening on each host immediately before pushing the locker via PsExec: VSS deletion → recovery disable → log clear → Defender tamper → critical-service stop.
